title: Email Recommendations
meta: Suggested products added to your emails, such as post purchase and browse follow ups. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
overview: We add suggested products to the emails you already send, so each message feels more relevant. Using your email tool's product blocks and your store data, we build recommendation sections for the post purchase email, the browse follow up and your regular newsletter. We design the block to match your email style, preview it on mobile and test it with real sample profiles, so you see how different customers will see it.

pkgs.blurb: A product block in one email template.
Blocks in three flows, with fallback items and mobile previews.
A recommendation set for flows and campaigns with tests.

faq: Which email tools do you work with?
Klaviyo, Shopify Email, Mailchimp and similar tools that offer product blocks. We check your plan first, since some features need a paid tier. You invite us as a user, never sharing a password.
Yes. We only use these blocks with contacts who agreed to marketing emails, keep unsubscribe links in place and follow your email tool's rules. Check consent laws in your region with your adviser.
What if a shopper has no history?
We set a fallback, such as best sellers or new arrivals, so the block is never empty. You can choose what the fallback should be.
Will you write the email copy?
We write short helper text for the product block. For full email copy and flows, see the AI marketing services page, which can be ordered separately.
